status: R2.2 declared parameter-search protocol; all data are phase-0 design records
objective: Equal-weight mean of full-record filtered MSE / unfiltered MSE across the five declared design conditions and their three repeats
refinement: Around the strict feasible coarse minimum, use the adjacent coarse values as bounds; seven evenly spaced odd lengths and thirteen half-widths rounded to the original 0.5 Hz grid; retain all coarse candidates
selection: Within 1% of the minimum feasible objective, choose the shortest kernel, then the lowest objective, then the narrowest band and registered window order
boundary: Zero extension; full linear convolution; fixed centred crop d=(M-1)/2
prior: Four centres measured from the R2.1 personal contaminated spectrum using openly declared R1 frequency priors
